subject.title: [v2026.3.24] Two regressions: browser tabs CLI syntax break + gateway cycling after doctor --fix

question: Should OpenClaw support an explicit daemon runtime pin or acknowledgement contract for version-manager Node paths, or keep the current supported-system-Node migration policy?
rationale: Current main intentionally warns on version-manager daemon paths, while the remaining gateway half would require a new public daemon install flag/env contract or an explicit rejection of that direction.

options.title: Sponsor runtime pinning
options.body: Refresh and prove the runtime-path PR with live supervisor evidence, then treat the new daemon pin as supported API.

options.title: Keep system Node policy
options.body: Document that supported system Node is the only supported repair target and close the gateway policy gap after the browser fix lands.

options.title: Split browser only
options.body: Land the browser parser fix now and leave the gateway runtime policy tracked only by the broader runtime-path issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor runtime pinning
recommendation.body: Refresh and prove the runtime-path PR with live supervisor evidence, then treat the new daemon pin as supported API.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across both shared CLI parsing and daemon runtime policy surfaces.
